rule: A weight hash or source identity is not functional evidence. Only a domain-specific repair adapter with independent post-repair functional evidence may move a model to PASS.

D01_CEREBRO.required_strategy: Source-bound teacher/student calibration followed by rank selection, quantization-aware fitting and held-out semantic evaluation.
D01_CEREBRO.known_failure: Rank-1 candidate has near-total reconstruction error and failed arithmetic tests.

D03_TRANSCRIPCION.required_strategy: New calibration corpus, feature-compatible encoder/decoder reconstruction and held-out WER evaluation; rejected ranks must not be repeated without new evidence.
D03_TRANSCRIPCION.known_failure: R29/R64/R96/adaptive R192 attempts did not pass WER acceptance.

D04_TRADUCTOR_INTELIGENTE.required_strategy: Architecture-aware tied-embedding/shared-head reconstruction, calibration and bilingual held-out translation evaluation.
D04_TRADUCTOR_INTELIGENTE.known_failure: Current compact candidate produces repetitive degenerate translations.

D05_INTELIGENCIA_DOCUMENTAL.required_strategy: Architecture-bound tensor reconstruction, processor/tokenizer compatibility audit and image/document extraction evaluation.
D05_INTELIGENCIA_DOCUMENTAL.known_failure: Model load evidence is not equivalent to completed generation or extraction quality.

D06_SISTEMA_INTELIGENTE.required_strategy: Architecture-aware layer reconstruction, calibration-aware fitting and held-out reasoning evaluation.
D06_SISTEMA_INTELIGENTE.known_failure: Current low-rank candidate fails arithmetic/reasoning acceptance.

D04_TRADUCCION_LENGUAS_ANTIGUAS.required_strategy: Licensed Latin/Ancient Greek source model or validated lexicon/transducer plus consumer adapter.
D04_TRADUCCION_LENGUAS_ANTIGUAS.known_failure: GPT-OSS specialist prompt is not an independently validated ancient-language engine.
